marking.method: a ✓ requires a NAMED TEST in this repository whose name contains the item's head noun, the item's rarest word, at least two of its words in total and 60% of them; ~ requires a source file matched the same way; ☐ means this script found neither, which is a statement about the script, not proof of absence.
